'''2007 Ohio State Championship Kendall Halman DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kendall Halman]] at [[2007 Ohio State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Kendall Holman
* '''Deck name:''' What is your dark side deck?
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
